scope.summary: Wire the pose-driven drape QA hook per Section 13.24: a matrix runner that drapes seeded archetype bodies against the starter garment set under QA poses and persists machine-readable per-cell results, providing the execution substrate the BkBodiesQA drape matrix (MT-643) and the 13.27 validation stages consume.
acceptance_criteria: The runner executes archetype x garment x pose cells: apply archetype recipe, pose the body (QA pose set), drape/refit the garment, and record per-cell metrics (interpenetration count, max penetration depth, settle determinism hash, fit metric).
Results persist as typed machine-readable rows keyed by (recipe_id, garment_id, pose_id, channel_state_hash) so stale cells are detectable when any input changes.
The hook is invocable as a validation stage by the 13.27 runner and as a standalone job; failures carry suggested_fix pointers naming the garment region or channel implicated.
A smoke matrix (2 archetypes x 2 garments x 2 poses) runs green in CI within the test-time budget.
scope.risk_if_missed: Bridge regressions (stale proxies, projection spikes, rigidity breaks) surface only when a human eyeballs a render, so the Cloth<->BodyKit contract silently rots between MTs.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile the BodyKit cloth bridge with shared topology/material/collider snapshots, the per-tier interaction matrix, portal-aware cavity metadata, final f64 authority, and promotion-safe receipts without expanding BodyKit anatomy authoring in this slice.
Pin PoseKit-derived pose fixtures plus character/body/garment/spec hashes in drape QA without treating PoseKit as 3D authority.
